name: Waldorf Wave
description: Waldorf Wave wavetable synthesizer, operating system 1.400: every sound parameter of its System Exclusive Description, sent to instrument 1's sound, with Pull of that sound.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/waldorf/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/waldorf/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a byte of the document's sound dump, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 3E 03 <dev> 09 <instrument> <parameter, two nibbles> <value> <CHK> F7, the parameter its byte in the sound dump (0 - 255), CHK the 7-bit sum of the bytes after 09. <dev> is the deviceId variable, the instrument's Device Number (0 unless set otherwise); its dumps are matched by it too.
No identity check: the document prints no identity reply.
Parameters go to instrument 1's sound (instrument 0), and Pull reads that instrument's sound; the Wave's other seven instruments are not laid out.
The Wave sends the same Sound Parameter dump (SBPRPAR) when a sound parameter is edited on its panel; CEditor reads those by byte.
Rows the document prints wrongly, given by the layout: 94 Dual mode highpass envelope select.
Pull: Soundprogram Dump Request (RQBPR), instrument 1. 225 of 225 parameters are read back.

coverage.inboundControllers: parameter changes the instrument sends are read by byte; its control changes are not mapped
